sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B is the compact dense model of Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date. Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5, it is a native vision-language model with substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, designed to carry complex multi-step work ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B — open weights, specs, benchmarks | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is the compact dense model in Alibaba's Qwen3.8 open-weight generation, published on Hugging Face in August 2026 under Apache 2.0 alongside an FP8 checkpoint. Its weights can be downloaded under the Apache-2.0 licence.
